about: Source spec for the base organ library (organs/). tools/organs/build.py turns each entry into a bake config (tools/meshes/configs/organ-<id>.json), bakes organs/meshes/<id>.js and writes organs/manifests/<id>.json. Centre lines are Z-Anatomy curve objects taken point for point (cm, body frame); landmarks are computed by the named rule from source geometry. A centre line with a 'parent' is oriented to start at the end nearest its parent centre line, and that end becomes the landmark '<id>_origin' (arteries, ducts, airways) or '<id>_junction' (veins).

zanatomy.source: Z-Anatomy Startup.blend (BodyParts3D-derived), extracted with tools/meshes/extract_blend.py --sides 16 --match-file tools/organs/zanatomy_organs.txt into zanatomy-organs/obj

totalseg.source: TotalSegmentator CT dataset v2.0.1 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.10047292), subject s1304 masks; tools/meshes/ct_to_obj.py, registered by tools/organs/register.py

rodero.source: Rodero et al. 2021 average heart (doi:10.5281/zenodo.4593739), per-chamber surfaces from rodero/work/parts, registered by tools/organs/register.py

bile_duct_onto_d2.why: In Z-Anatomy the bile duct runs on the anterior surface of the pancreatic head and ends 0.5 cm in front of the anterior wall of the descending duodenum (1.1 cm anterior to the centre of its slab at that height); the bile duct descends behind the first part of the duodenum and through the back of the pancreatic head and enters the posteromedial wall of the descending part at the major papilla. The duct is rotated rigidly about its upper end (kept where the cystic and common hepatic ducts would join) so its lower end reaches the posteromedial wall (direction medial + posterior) of the descending duodenum's source mesh at the same height.
